sourceZh: 备周则意怠，常见则不疑。阴在阳之内，不在阳之对。
explanationZh: 示敌以平常，掩其真实意图，使对手在习以为常中失去戒备。
storyZh: 薛仁贵为惧海的唐太宗造"大宅"宴饮，实则巨舟渡海，瞒过君王而成的奇袭。
modern: 越想做成大事，越要把动作做得"像日常一样"。谈判、转型时，把关键一步包装成例行流程，阻力最小。
sourceEn: When precautions are complete, vigilance slackens; the familiar is trusted. The hidden lies within the obvious, not apart from it.
explanationEn: Show the ordinary to hide the extraordinary, so the enemy drops its guard through sheer familiarity.
storyEn: Xue Rengui built a "mansion" for the sea-fearing Emperor Taizong and feasted him while a great ship carried them across — a surprise landing hidden in plain sight.
reflection: The enduring truth: what is shown openly is rarely questioned. Mastery is making the decisive move look like routine.

sourceZh: 共敌不如分敌，敌阳不如敌阴。
explanationZh: 不直接救赵，而攻魏都大梁，迫使庞涓回师，于归途设伏取胜。
storyZh: 桂陵之战，孙膑围魏都大梁，解赵围并生擒庞涓。
modern: 正面冲突成本高时，绕到对方必救之处施压，逼其自撤，比硬碰硬省力得多。
sourceEn: To attack a massed enemy, divide it; strike where it is weak rather than meet its strength head-on.
explanationEn: Instead of relieving Zhao directly, strike Wei’s capital so the enemy must turn back — then ambush it worn and divided.
storyEn: At Guiling, Sun Bin besieged Wei’s capital, broke the siege of Zhao, and captured Pang Juan on the march.
reflection: Pressure the point your opponent cannot abandon; they will retreat from where you are weak to defend where they are weak.

sourceZh: 敌已明，友未定，引友杀敌，不自出力，以《损》推演。
explanationZh: 借他人之手除掉对手，自己置身事外，干净而无痕。
storyZh: 子贡游说齐、吴、晋，借四国相争保全鲁国，不动一兵而扭转局势。
modern: 善用第三方力量与规则去解决难题：让平台、流程、他人去"出手"，你只需设计局面。
sourceEn: The foe is clear but allies unsteady — induce an ally to strike, spending no force of your own.
explanationEn: Use another’s hand to remove your rival, keeping yourself clear of the blow and the blame.
storyEn: Zigong shuttled between Qi, Wu and Jin, turning four states against one another to save Lu without lifting a sword.
reflection: Agents endure; the hand that strikes is seldom the hand that gains. Design the board, let others move the pieces.

sourceZh: 困敌之势，不以战；损刚益柔。
explanationZh: 养精蓄锐，待敌奔疲再出击，以静制动、以饱待饥。
storyZh: 长勺之战，曹刿待齐军三鼓气竭，方挥师反击，一鼓破之。
modern: 别在低谷硬拼。蓄力、等对手自乱或耗尽资源，再一举翻盘，效率远高于 continual 消耗。
nameEn: Wait at Leisure for the Exhausted
sourceEn: Exhaust the enemy’s momentum without battle; wear the hard away to strengthen the soft.
explanationEn: Conserve your strength and strike only when the enemy is spent — meet motion with stillness.
storyEn: At Changshao, Cao Gui let the Qi army exhaust three war-drums of spirit, then struck and broke them at once.
reflection: Rest is not idleness; it is the compounding of strength while the opponent spends theirs to nothing.

sourceZh: 敌之害大，就势取利，刚决柔也。
explanationZh: 对手遭难、内部动荡时，顺手取利，扩张自身。
storyZh: 吴国趁楚平王新丧、朝局混乱攻入郢都，大获其利。
modern: 别人危机时是你的窗口：并购、抢人才、补位，皆宜"趁火"而非趁人之危于道义之外。
sourceEn: When the enemy’s calamity is great, seize the advantage — the firm resolves what the soft cannot.
explanationEn: When a rival is stricken and disordered, take the gain while the opening lasts.
storyEn: Wu invaded the Chu capital Ying amid the turmoil following King Ping’s death, reaping the reward of chaos.
reflection: Crisis reveals vacancy; the prepared move into the empty space others cannot hold.

sourceZh: 敌志乱萃，不虞，坤下兑上之象，利其不自主而取之。
explanationZh: 制造假动向，牵制敌方注意力，真实一击另择其处。
storyZh: 李愬雪夜袭蔡州，明攻一路、暗取蔡州，生擒吴元济。
modern: 汇报、营销、谈判中都可用：把注意力引向 A，资源压在 B，出奇制胜。
sourceEn: The enemy’s will is scattered and unprepared; profit from its loss of command and take it.
explanationEn: Create a false thrust to fix the enemy’s eye, then deliver the real blow elsewhere.
storyEn: Li Su marched in a snowy night, feinting one route while seizing Caizhou and capturing Wu Yuanji.
reflection: Attention is a finite resource; whoever directs it, commands the field.

sourceZh: 诳也，非诳也，实其所诳也。少阴、太阴、太阳。
explanationZh: 先以虚张造势，待敌信以为真，再落 REAL 一子反客为主。
storyZh: 张仪许楚"商於六百里"，诱怀王绝齐，地未至而楚已孤立。
modern: 创意与提案常"先有框架再填内容"：用雏形撬动资源，边做边实。但信用一旦耗损难补。
sourceEn: Deceive, then not deceive — make the deception real. From small falsehood to great truth.
explanationEn: First feign emptiness until it is believed, then plant a real move within the belief.
storyEn: Zhang Yi promised Chu "six hundred li" to break its alliance with Qi; the land never came, yet Chu was already isolated.
reflection: From nothing a beginning is made; the danger is when the nothing was promised as something.

sourceZh: 示之以动，利其静而有主，益动而巽。
explanationZh: 明修栈道佯动，暗出奇兵于不备之处，出敌不意。
storyZh: 韩信明修栈道、暗度陈仓，一举还定三秦。
modern: 公开走流程稳住关注，私下推进真正关键路径——项目管理与竞争皆然。
sourceEn: Show one movement to fix a static, over-confident foe; then advance where unguarded.
explanationEn: Repair the roads openly, march by a hidden route; the obvious distracts from the real.
storyEn: Han Xin openly rebuilt the plank roads while secretly marching through Chencang, reclaiming the Three Qin.
reflection: The visible plan protects the invisible one; concentration follows the decoy.

sourceZh: 阳乖序乱，阴以待逆。暴戾恣睢，其势自毙。
explanationZh: 不急于介入，静观对手内斗，待其两败俱伤再收。
storyZh: 曹操坐视袁谭、袁尚兄弟相攻，各个击破，尽有河北。
modern: 争端中别抢着当裁判或掺和；有时最佳动作是"不动作"，让局势先沉淀。
nameEn: Watch the Fires Across the River
sourceEn: When rivals turn on each other in disorder, wait in the shadows; their fury exhausts itself.
explanationEn: Do not rush in; watch opponents tear each other apart, then gather what remains.
storyEn: Cao Cao let the Yuan brothers war on each other, then defeated them one by one and took Hebei.
reflection: Intervention too early buys another’s war; patience lets others pay its price.

sourceZh: 信而安之，阴以图之；备而后动，勿使有变。
explanationZh: 外表温和亲善，内怀图谋，于对方松懈时下手。
storyZh: 李林甫口蜜腹剑，表面交好、暗中构陷，为政敌所惧。
modern: 识别"过度热情的让步"：关系里突如其来的好意，先想对方图什么。
nameEn: Hide a Knife in a Smile
sourceEn: Lull with trust, plot in secret; prepare, then move before the change comes.
explanationEn: Wear warmth and goodwill while the blade is readied within; strike as the guard drops.
storyEn: Li Linfu spoke honey yet bore a sword; he befriended then ruined those in his way.
reflection: A smile is a mask; wisdom asks what the mask protects.

sourceZh: 势必有损，损阴以益阳。
explanationZh: 以局部、次要的牺牲，保全整体或关键利益。
storyZh: 赵氏孤儿中，程婴以己子替赵武赴死，存赵氏血脉。
modern: 取舍的本质：敢于用小代价换大结果，不纠结于"全胜"。
nameEn: Substitute the Plum for the Peach
sourceEn: Loss is inevitable — sacrifice the lesser to preserve the greater.
explanationEn: Trade a minor loss for a vital gain; protect the trunk by letting a branch fall.
storyEn: In the Zhao orphan tale, Cheng Ying gave his own son to save Zhao Wu and the clan’s line.
reflection: Not every piece can be saved; the art is knowing which to let go.

sourceZh: 微隙在所必乘，微利在所必得。
explanationZh: 乘势取小利、补小漏，积小胜为大势，不轻易放过。
storyZh: 秦袭郑不成，返程顺手灭滑国，一举两得。
modern: 执行中出现的边角机会（客户、素材、流量）顺手拿下，别只盯主目标。
sourceEn: Exploit every tiny gap; take every small gain that presents itself.
explanationEn: While moving, pocket the opening at hand — small gains compound into position.
storyEn: Having failed at Zheng, the Qin army on return conveniently destroyed the state of Hua.
reflection: The main road rarely yields all; the side path often holds the extra.

sourceZh: 疑以叩实，察而后动；复者，阴之媒也。
explanationZh: 以试探之举逼出对手虚实，再据实情定策。
storyZh: 南唐王鲁判案，民告主簿，王鲁惊"汝虽打草，吾已蛇惊"，原指自露。
modern: 调研、A/B 测试、试探性报价，都是"打草"：用低代价动作换取信息。
nameEn: Beat the Grass to Frighten the Snake
sourceEn: Probe to surface the hidden; observe, then act. Repetition is the mother of the unseen.
explanationEn: A small probe draws the hidden into the open; act on what the probe reveals.
storyEn: Judge Wang Lu, hearing a complaint against his clerk, blurted "you beat the grass, but I am the startled snake" — the probe exposed the probe.
reflection: Information is bought cheapest by those willing to seem to act.

sourceZh: 有用者，不可借；不能用者，求借。
explanationZh: 借已被弃之物或名义，注入新意，使其重焕作用。
storyZh: 刘备借荆州立足，借"宗室"之名行崛起之实。
modern: 旧产品、旧 IP、旧关系皆可"借尸"：换包装、换场景即获新生。
nameEn: Borrow a Corpse to Revive the Soul
sourceEn: What is useful cannot be borrowed; borrow what others have discarded.
explanationEn: Take a form others abandoned, breathe new purpose into it, and it lives again.
storyEn: Liu Bei "borrowed" Jingzhou and the prestige of imperial kinship to root his rise.
reflection: What is dead to one owner may yet serve another who sees the form.

sourceZh: 待天以困之，用人以诱之。
explanationZh: 诱强敌离开有利地形或位置，于其失势处击之。
storyZh: 孙策诱刘勋远攻上缭，乘虚取庐江。
modern: 谈判或竞争中，把关键人物/资源引出其舒适区（主场、习惯），胜算骤增。
nameEn: Lure the Tiger Off the Mountain
sourceEn: Use circumstance to hem him in, use men to draw him out.
explanationEn: Coax the strong opponent from his ground, then strike where he is powerless.
storyEn: Sun Ce lured Liu Xun away to attack Shangliao, then seized his Lujiang stronghold.
reflection: Strength is place; remove the place and the strength leaks away.

sourceZh: 逼则反兵，走则减势。紧随勿迫，累其气力，消其斗志。
explanationZh: 先放对手一马，松其防备、耗其心力，再从容收网。
storyZh: 诸葛亮七擒七纵孟获，终使其心服南中平定。
modern: 管理与人脉：逼太紧则反弹，给空间反而赢得长久服从。
sourceEn: Pressing breeds resistance; releasing lessens force. Follow close but do not press, wearing down will and strength.
explanationEn: Let the prey run so its guard drops and strength fades, then close the net at leisure.
storyEn: Zhuge Liang captured and released Meng Huo seven times until he submitted wholly, pacifying the south.
reflection: Command that is felt as freedom is the command that lasts.

sourceZh: 类以诱之，击蒙也。
explanationZh: 先抛粗浅之物或意见，引对方亮出更佳者，借以获益。
storyZh: 常建先题破句于寺壁，引赵嘏续成佳句，遂得"抛砖引玉"。
modern: 分享半成品、抛观点，常比藏私更能换来回馈与协作。
nameEn: Throw a Brick to Attract Jade
sourceEn: Offer something of its kind to lure it; strike the unenlightened with a model.
explanationEn: Lead with a modest offering to draw out a richer one in return.
storyEn: Chang Jian wrote an incomplete verse on a temple wall to draw Zhao Gu into finishing a finer one.
reflection: The giver of the first stone often receives the finer.

sourceZh: 摧其坚，夺其魁，以解其体。
explanationZh: 直取核心人物或枢纽，全局随之瓦解。
storyZh: 张巡守睢阳，射瞎叛将尹子奇，敌军攻势顿挫。
modern: 解决问题抓"关键人/关键节点"：换掉瓶颈角色，整件事就通了。
sourceEn: Shatter the solid, seize the chief, and the body dissolves.
explanationEn: Strike the head — remove the center and the whole scatters.
storyEn: Defending Suiyang, Zhang Xun shot the rebel general Yin Ziq i blind, collapsing the assault.
reflection: Cut the head and the body stills; find the head in every system.

sourceZh: 不敌其力，而消其势。
explanationZh: 不硬扛，而从根本断其赖以持续的资源或原因。
storyZh: 周亚夫平七国之乱，断吴楚粮道，不战而乱其军。
modern: 对抗坏习惯、对手、危机，先断"供养"：资金、习惯触发器、信息源。
nameEn: Remove the Firewood from the Cauldron
sourceEn: Do not meet its force; remove the momentum beneath it.
explanationEn: Rather than fight the flame, pull away what feeds it.
storyEn: Zhou Yafu crushed the Seven Kingdoms revolt by cutting Wu-Chu supply lines, not by frontal battle.
reflection: Every fire has wood; remove it and the blaze becomes memory.

sourceZh: 乘其阴乱，利其弱而无主。
explanationZh: 趁局面混乱、对手无主，从容取利或占位。
storyZh: 刘备趁荆州易主之乱，顺势据有荆州立足。
modern: 行业动荡、组织重组期，正是低位切入、抢定义权的最佳窗口。
sourceEn: Profit from its inner disorder, its weakness and lack of command.
explanationEn: When the water is muddied and none commands, reach in and take.
storyEn: Liu Bei seized Jingzhou amid its repeated upheavals, gaining a footing.
reflection: Order crowns its king; disorder crowns the quick.

sourceZh: 存其形，完其势；友不疑，敌不动。
explanationZh: 留假象稳住局面，暗中将实力或自身抽离转移。
storyZh: 狄青征侬智高，留空营疑兵，潜师绕后破敌。
modern: 离职、撤退、转型时，保留"仍在"的表象，争取转移的时间与空间。
sourceEn: Keep the form, complete the posture; friends doubt not, foes move not.
explanationEn: Leave a shell that holds the shape, and slip the living thing away unseen.
storyEn: Di Qing left an empty camp as a decoy and secretly marched around to crush Nong Zhigao.
reflection: The shape remains; the life has already gone. The wise flee without appearing to move.

sourceZh: 小敌困之。剥，不利有攸往。
explanationZh: 对弱小对手先围困断其退路，再从容歼灭，不使其逸。
storyZh: 白起长平围赵括大军，断粮道、封退路，坑杀四十万。
modern: 处理小问题要"封口"再做：别让小漏洞扩散成必须救火的大洞。
nameEn: Shut the Door to Catch the Thief
sourceEn: Hem in a small foe. To let it roam is to lose the advantage.
explanationEn: Encircle a weaker foe and seal the exit, then take it at leisure.
storyEn: At Changping, Bai Qi encircled Zhao Kuo’s army, cut its supplies and exits, and destroyed it.
reflection: A thief in the open is a war; a thief in the locked room is a catch.

sourceZh: 形禁势格，利从近取，害以远隔。
explanationZh: 结好远者不急于动，先吃下邻近可取的，步步为营。
storyZh: 范雎献秦昭王"远交近攻"，终蚕食六国而一统。
modern: 资源有限时，先拿下最近、最稳的市场/客户，远方的联盟留作缓冲。
nameEn: Befriend the Distant, Attack the Near
sourceEn: When geography and power bind you, gain from the near, harm the far only at cost.
explanationEn: Court the distant as friend, strike the near as prey; expand by adjacency.
storyEn: Fan Ju urged King Zhaoxiang to befriend far states and attack near ones, uniting China by degrees.
reflection: Alliances are for those you will not yet fight; conquest is for those beside you.

sourceZh: 两大之间，敌胁以从，我假以势。
explanationZh: 借道于第三方，行灭其邻之实，回师顺势并吞借道者。
storyZh: 晋献公借道虞国灭虢，归途顺手灭虞。
modern: 合作里要防"被借道"：允许别人用你的渠道/名声，可能反噬自身。
nameEn: Borrow a Passage to Attack Guo
sourceEn: Between two great powers, the enemy coerces; I lend my strength as pretext.
explanationEn: Borrow a road through one state to strike another, then absorb the lender on the way home.
storyEn: Duke Xian of Jin borrowed passage through Yu to destroy Guo, then extinguished Yu on his return.
reflection: He who lends the road often becomes the next destination.

sourceZh: 频更其阵，抽其劲旅，待其自败。
explanationZh: 暗中替换关键人或规则，使对手结构朽坏而不觉。
storyZh: 赵高沙丘矫诏，废扶苏立胡亥，偷换秦室之"梁"。
modern: 组织与合同中，关键条款/人选被悄悄替换最致命，须盯住"梁"而非门面。
nameEn: Replace the Beams with Rotten Pillars
sourceEn: Shift his formation often, draw off his best, and await his collapse.
explanationEn: Quietly swap the load-bearing parts so the whole rots from within.
storyEn: At Shaqiu, Zhao Gao forged the edict, removed Fusu and installed Huhai, swapping the pillars of Qin.
reflection: The facade stands; the beam is gone. Collapse comes not with a crash but a silence.

sourceZh: 大凌小者，警以诱之。
explanationZh: 借责备甲，实则警示乙，以旁敲侧击达成统御。
storyZh: 孙武斩吴王宠姬立威，全军肃然听令。
modern: 带团队时，公开纠一个、立规矩于众，比逐个训斥高效。
nameEn: Point at the Mulberry, Curse the Locust
sourceEn: To command the great over the small, warn one to guide the other.
explanationEn: Reprove one openly to caution another without naming him.
storyEn: Sun Wu beheaded King Wu’s favored concubines to drill the army, and all obeyed.
reflection: The spoken name is seldom the one that listens.

sourceZh: 宁伪作不知不为，不伪作假知妄为。
explanationZh: 装糊涂藏锋芒，避祸待时，外钝内明。
storyZh: 司马懿装病多年，待曹爽松懈一举夺权。
modern: 职场与新环境里，适度"装不懂"可避锋芒、换观察时间。
sourceEn: Better to feign ignorance and do nothing than fake knowledge and act rashly.
explanationEn: Play the fool to hide your edge; stay harmless in appearance, sharp within.
storyEn: Sima Yi feigned illness for years, then seized power once Cao Shuang let his guard fall.
reflection: Madness professed is a shield; the still mind behind it is the sword.

sourceZh: 假之以便，唆之使前，断其援应。
explanationZh: 诱敌深入或上位，再断其退路，使其进退维谷。
storyZh: 刘琦登楼问计，诸葛亮教其抽梯自请外镇避祸。
modern: 给人"上位"的机会同时截断其退路，可令其不得不向前——慎用，属险招。
nameEn: Remove the Ladder After the Ascent
sourceEn: Offer a convenience, urge him forward, then cut his support.
explanationEn: Lure him up, then pull away the ladder so retreat is impossible.
storyEn: Liu Qi climbed the tower to ask Zhuge Liang’s counsel; Zhuge had the ladder drawn up, prompting him to seek a post away.
reflection: He who climbs willingly need not be pushed; only the ladder need vanish.

sourceZh: 借局布势，力小势大。
explanationZh: 实力不足时，借阵势、排场、信号虚张声势，慑服对手。
storyZh: 张飞长坂坡据水断桥、令兵植矛林立，疑兵退曹军。
modern: 初创与弱势方靠"排面"：官网、案例、数据可视化，先造势再求实。
nameEn: Put Fake Blossoms on the Tree
sourceEn: Borrow a setting to build presence; small force, grand appearance.
explanationEn: When weak, inflate presence with arrangement and signal; appearance alone may decide.
storyEn: At Changban, Zhang Fei stood alone by the bridge with spears planted like a forest, and Cao’s army withdrew in dread.
reflection: Men follow the appearance of strength; often the appearance is enough.

sourceZh: 乘隙插足，扼其主机。
explanationZh: 先以客位介入，渐握枢纽，终反制主导。
storyZh: 刘邦入关中先入咸阳、约法三章，反客为主定天下基。
modern: 合作中先占关键岗位/数据/接口，逐步从执行方变规则方。
sourceEn: Slip in through the gap, then seize the master’s switch.
explanationEn: Enter as guest, grasp the key post, and become the host.
storyEn: Liu Bang entered the capital first, proclaimed light laws, and turned guest into master of the realm.
reflection: The guest who learns the house becomes its keeper.

sourceZh: 兵强者，攻其将；将智者，伐其情。
explanationZh: 以美色接近关键人物，乱其心智、松其防备。
storyZh: 越王勾践献西施于夫差，乱其政而终灭吴。
modern: 现代隐喻：用"讨好/顺意"软化决策者警惕——识破他人用美色或甜头接近你时保持清醒。
sourceEn: Against a strong army, strike its general; against a wise general, strike his heart.
explanationEn: Send beauty close to the key figure to cloud his judgment and lower his guard.
storyEn: Goujian sent Xi Shi to King Fuchai, muddling his rule until Yue destroyed Wu.
reflection: Desire is the oldest gate; through it even the strongest falls.

sourceZh: 虚者虚之，疑中生疑。
explanationZh: 以虚张镇定惑敌，使强敌疑有埋伏而不敢进。
storyZh: 诸葛亮抚琴坐空城，司马懿疑有伏兵而退。
modern: 当你"底牌不足"时，镇定与节奏感常比实料更能吓退试探。
sourceEn: Show emptiness as emptiness, and doubt breeds doubt.
explanationEn: Project calm emptiness so the foe suspects an ambush and dares not advance.
storyEn: Zhuge Liang played the zither in an open city; Sima Yi, fearing a trap, withdrew.
reflection: What is empty, shown without fear, becomes a question the enemy answers by leaving.

sourceZh: 疑中之疑。比之自内，不自失也。
explanationZh: 向敌中掺入假情报，使其自疑、自残、内斗。
storyZh: 周瑜借蒋干递假书，使曹操斩水将蔡瑁、张允。
modern: 信息战核心：不是自己出手，而是让对手基于假信息"自己出错"。
sourceEn: Doubt within doubt. Set the foe against himself from within; thus we lose nothing.
explanationEn: Plant false intelligence so the enemy suspects and destroys his own.
storyEn: Zhou Yu used the envoy Jiang Gan to deliver a forged letter, prompting Cao Cao to execute his own admirals.
reflection: The best spy makes the enemy his own executioner.

sourceZh: 人不自害，受害必疑。
explanationZh: 自伤以取信于敌，行诈降或内应，险而效显。
storyZh: 黄盖诈降曹操，周瑜痛打黄盖以坚其信，火烧赤壁。
modern: 信任需"代价"支撑：愿付成本（自损）者，别人更易信其诚意——双刃，慎用于真实关系。
sourceEn: No man harms himself; therefore a man harmed is suspected of a plot.
explanationEn: Hurt yourself to earn the enemy’s trust, then strike from within.
storyEn: Huang Gai offered to defect; Zhou Yu had him flogged to prove it, then fired the Red Cliffs.
reflection: Belief is bought by pain; the wound that is shown is the wound that is trusted.

sourceZh: 将多兵众，不可以敌，使其自累。
explanationZh: 数计相接，环环相扣，使敌疲于应付、自相牵制。
storyZh: 王允以貂蝉连环离间董卓吕布，终除暴逆。
modern: 复杂目标拆成连环动作：每一步都为下一步铺势，而非一役定胜负。
sourceEn: Against many and mighty, do not meet them; make them burden themselves.
explanationEn: Link stratagems in a chain so the enemy is entangled and exhausts himself.
storyEn: Wang Yun used Diao Chan to chain Dong Zhuo and Lü Bu against each other, then destroyed them.
reflection: One stratagem is parried; a chain of them the mind cannot unwind.

sourceZh: 全师避敌。左次无咎，未失常也。
explanationZh: 势不敌时主动撤退保全实力，留得青山，再图后举。
storyZh: 晋文公"退避三舍"避楚锋芒，终城濮一战而霸。
modern: 及时止损、体面退出，是成年人最被低估的能力：退出不等于输。
sourceEn: Withdraw the whole army from the foe. To step back in order is no fault, for it preserves the norm.
explanationEn: When the odds are lost, retire intact — keep the mountain green for another day.
storyEn: Duke Wen of Jin "retreated three days’ march" to avoid Chu’s edge, then won at Chengpu and became hegemon.
reflection: To retreat in order is not defeat; it is the field kept for the next victory.

bodyZh: 计在敌明我强、主动权在握之时。核心是"以正合、以奇胜"：用伪装与调度把优势转化为致命一击，而非蛮力硬碰。
themeEn: The Art of Offense from Strength
bodyEn: These are used when you hold the initiative. The theme is turning strength into a decisive blow through disguise and timing, not brute force.

themeZh: 敌我对峙中的欺敌之道
bodyZh: 双方势均、正面难分之时，靠"无中生有""笑里藏刀"等虚实战法乱敌心智，于均势中撕开裂口。
themeEn: The Art of Deceiving a Peer Foe
bodyEn: Used when foes are evenly matched. Deception, false warmth and feigned weakness open a seam in a balanced field.

themeZh: 主动进攻中的取势之道
bodyZh: 转入进攻时要"擒王""抽薪"：直取枢纽、断其根本，并以欲擒故纵消磨对手意志，攻其要害而非其表。
themeEn: The Art of Seizing the Initiative
bodyEn: Once attacking, strike the center and cut the source. Release to exhaust, then capture the chief.

bodyZh: 局势纷乱、敌无主见时，浑水摸鱼、金蝉脱壳、关门捉贼——在混乱里取利、脱身、收口。
themeEn: The Art of Thriving in Chaos
bodyEn: When all is disorder, fish in troubled water, shed the shell, shut the door. Chaos is the opportunist’s weather.

themeZh: 势均力敌时的并争之道
bodyZh: 与强敌并立、互不相下时，用偷梁换柱、指桑骂槐、反客为主等法，于细微处潜移主导权。
themeEn: The Art of Contending as Equals
bodyEn: As equals locked together, shift the beams, warn by indirection, and turn guest into host — power moves through the small.

bodyZh: 身处下风甚至将败时，美人、空城、反间、苦肉、连环、走——以奇险换生机，最坏处亦留退路。
themeEn: The Art of Turning Defeat Around
bodyEn: When losing, beauty, empty fort, discord, self-wound, chains and retreat turn doom into a second chance.
